intended_user_behavior: A queued old USB/peripheral User-mode Solo NoteOff must never release a fresh direct BLE Solo pressed after SMC reconnect; valid fresh host/BLE NoteOns and matched NoteOffs still work.
failure: BLE link epoch clears all held Solo, but the host ring retained a pre-epoch NoteOff that drained after a new direct BLE NoteOn on the same strip, clearing the new press.
correction: TIMER5 publishes host queue cutoff in existing BLE-link seqlock. smc_poll filters only pre-edge host Solo NoteOff frames for that link transition, preserving other host MIDI and post-edge NoteOffs.
scope: Single source path firmware/src/app/smc_mixer.c plus 3 existing owned host regression harnesses and this evidence JSON. Does not alter BLE SDK, firmware main/nightly, bootloader, installer, sample slots or hardware.

native_test.new_solo_lifetime: 78/78 scenarios passed per configuration, 384 assertions. Compared with prior 66/66 scenarios.
native_test.negative_test: Old exact R12 C source must fail runtime assertion 'fresh Solo must survive stale pre-edge host NoteOff', not fail compilation.
native_test.caveats: Source-window mocked callbacks/ISR; not full-source-root QA, physical ISR timing, target compilation or hardware PASS. LeakSanitizer was not run.
